finding: The money path dead-ends at the progress bar: nothing wires the in-progress state to either outcome, so a reviewer walking the flow never reaches the live site or the failure.
evidence: Full reaction dump of 784:4250 carries exactly three edges: frame-level ON_CLICK -> 817:5220 '[not-implemented] S6.4 · deploy-progress-pipeline', 784:4286 'Panel footer' -> 833:4518 (back to the checklist), 787:4377 'hotspot/back' -> 641:2652. Inbound scan of the whole page: 784:4326 'Publish · live' in=1 and 784:4403 'Publish · failed' in=1, and in BOTH cases the single inbound is 641:2652 via a 'hotspot/state' reviewer chip (787:4379 / 787:4383), not a flow edge. The job really does resolve to one of the two: usePublishJob.ts:299-310 maps COMPLETED->published and FAILED->failed.
fix: Wire 784:4250 -> 784:4326 as the ON_CLICK success edge (the board already exists), and add a 'hotspot/alt · failed' on 784:4250 -> 784:4403 the way 833:4518 carries 893:6935 for its blocked variant. Keep the S6.4 frame-level edge as the concept jump or move it onto its own hotspot so it stops swallowing every click.

finding: Connect Vercel is a closed loop — the one state that hard-blocks every publish offers a CTA that never reaches a connect screen, even though the destination board exists.
evidence: 893:4518 'Connect Vercel' (893:4577) -> 784:4480; 784:4480 'Connect Vercel' (784:4516 'Panel footer') -> 833:4518; 833:4518 -> 893:4518 via hotspot 893:6935. Closed cycle, no OAuth/integrations board reached. The check is a hard fail: publish.service.ts:52-56 comments it is the only hard fail besides Pages ready, thrown again at publish.service.ts:312-315 as VERCEL_NOT_CONNECTED. The code sends the user out of the editor: PublishTab.tsx:681 and PublishTab.tsx:775 both window.open(`${DASHBOARD_URL}/dashboard/settings/integrations`). A board for that destination already exists — 640:3488 'S7 · Settings · Integrations' in section 21.
fix: Point 784:4516 and 893:4577 (and the dead 893:4585 'Connect' link, see W-D-08) at 640:3488 'S7 · Settings · Integrations' instead of back into the Publish loop, and draw a return hotspot from 640:3488 to 833:4518 mirroring the ones 638:3070 / 639:3092 already carry (915:6880 / 915:6882).

finding: 'View live site' — the payoff of the entire money path, the one link to the URL the user just paid the flow to produce — has no reaction, and the board's frame-level edge sends the click to an unbuilt board instead.
evidence: Leaf inventory of 784:4326: TEXT 784:4386 "View live site" rx=0. The only reactions on the board are 784:4326 frame-level -> 807:8787 '[not-implemented] S6.3 · publish-changelog · diff-summary', 784:4362 'Panel footer' -> 833:4518, 787:4381 'hotspot/back' -> 641:2652. Because the frame-level edge catches every click, pressing 'View live site' navigates to the changelog concept board. In code it is a real external link: PublishTab.tsx:471-481 renders <a href={publishedUrl} target=_blank> (href at :474, label View live site at :479).
fix: Give 784:4386 its own ON_CLICK. The destination is outside the file (the customer's deployed site), so wire it to a small terminal 'opens the live site in a new tab' board, or mark it an external-link affordance; either way it must not resolve to 807:8787. Move the S6.3 edge off the frame onto a 'hotspot/concept' node so it stops intercepting.

finding: 'Try again' on the failed publish — the only recovery action on the money path — has no reaction, so the failure state offers no drawn way to retry.
evidence: Leaf inventory of 784:4403: TEXT 784:4463 "Try again" rx=0. The board's only reactions are 784:4439 'Panel footer' -> 833:4518 and 787:4385 'hotspot/back' -> 641:2652, and unlike 784:4326 this board has no frame-level edge, so the click is genuinely inert. The control is fully built in code: PublishTab.tsx:344-353 renders it and calls publishJob?.reset?.() (:347) then setWizardOpen(true) (:348), label at :352.
fix: Wire 784:4463 -> 833:4518 'Publish · pre-checks', which is exactly what the code does (reset the job, reopen the wizard at its Review step).

finding: The second job — take my site down — is not drawn anywhere: no unpublish confirm dialog exists on any of the 14 boards, though the flow is fully built and destructive.
evidence: PublishTab.tsx:814-822 renders <ConfirmDialog title="Unpublish site?" tone="destructive" confirmLabel="Unpublish"> with the message '<siteName> will be taken offline and its public URL will stop working until you publish again.' It is reachable from two doors: the panel's own control (PublishTab.tsx:615-624) and the site menu (StudioHeader.tsx:803 emits EVENTS.UI_UNPUBLISH_REQUEST, received at PublishTab.tsx:190). Server side it deletes the production deployment and flips the site to DRAFT (publish.service.ts:602-636). Page-wide board-name search for /unpublish|take.?down/ returned zero boards.
fix: Draw 'Publish · unpublish-confirm (modal)' at 520 wide with the code's verbatim copy, a destructive-tone confirm and a cancel, plus the refused variant (see W-D-23). Wire it from the entry control added in W-D-17, and give it edges: Cancel -> 641:2652, Unpublish -> a taken-offline panel state.

finding: 'View log' has no reaction and no destination board, yet the build log behind it is now fully built and is the only thing that tells the user which step failed and which never ran.
evidence: Leaf inventory of 784:4403: TEXT 784:4464 "View log" rx=0; the board carries no frame-level edge. PublishTab.tsx:362-371 renders the toggle (label at :370) and PublishTab.tsx:374-404 the expanded list (<ul aria-label=Build log> at :375), per step glyph plus a status word from STEP_WORD (PublishTab.tsx:850-855). PublishService.ts:40-49 documents that the steps column was carried through specifically for this control. The worker writes five steps (workers/publish/[jobId]/route.ts:22-28).
fix: Wire 784:4464 to the new expanded-log board (W-D-21). Because the log expands inline rather than navigating, the honest wiring is 784:4403 -> a duplicate of itself with the list open.

finding: 'Try again' on the deploy-service-unreachable state is dead, while the disabled-looking footer button beside it carries the board's only forward edge — the affordances are inverted.
evidence: Leaf inventory of 781:4489: TEXT 781:4548 "Try again" rx=0; the only reactions are 781:4525 'Panel footer' -> 833:4518 and 787:4373 'hotspot/back' -> 641:2652. The screenshot shows the footer 'Publish to production' rendered in the grey disabled treatment while 'Try again' is drawn as an active blue link. In code 'Try again' calls snapshot.reload() (PublishTab.tsx:443-450, snapshot.reload() at :445) and the footer button is genuinely disabled on snapshot.error (PublishTab.tsx:698).
fix: Wire 781:4548 -> 778:4238 'Publish · loading' (a retry re-enters the loading state, which is what reload() produces), and remove the reaction from 781:4525 since the code disables that button in this state.

finding: The 'Connect' link on the failing Vercel row is dead — the row-level fix for the only check that blocks every publish.
evidence: Leaf inventory of 893:4518: TEXT 893:4585 "Connect" rx=0, while the four 'Fix ›' links on the warning rows below it (893:4547, 893:4554, 893:4561, 893:4568) all carry reactions. In code this row is special-cased precisely because its fix is not in the editor: PublishTab.tsx:780-789 renders it as an <a href={`${DASHBOARD_URL}/dashboard/settings/integrations`}> (href at :784) rather than a tab switch, and PublishWizard.tsx:202-206 explains why the Vercel block is worded as its own sentence.
fix: Wire 893:4585 -> 640:3488 'S7 · Settings · Integrations', the same destination as the footer CTA in W-D-02.

finding: 'Compare v14 → v15' on the just-published state is dead, though the destination family exists and the code knows exactly where it goes.
evidence: Leaf inventory of 784:4326: TEXT 784:4387 "Compare v14 → v15" rx=0. PublishTab.tsx:482-490 renders it conditionally (ui:switch-tab at :486, label at :489) on snapshot.lastDeploy.version > 1 and calls composer?.emit('ui:switch-tab', { tab: 'history' }). A History section exists on the page (1776:8374 '16 · History · 34'), and PublishTab.tsx:653-661 names History · Published (949:4474) as the canonical destination for version-to-version questions.
fix: Wire 784:4387 -> the History board that draws the published-version comparison (949:4474 or its diff view), matching the tab the code switches to.

finding: Confirm's Back button drops the user on a board that is explicitly not built, and not on the step they actually arrived from.
evidence: 914:4545 '← Back' ON_CLICK -> 912:4520 '[design-ahead] Publish · Options'. The inbound scan shows users reach 914:4507 from 833:4518 via 833:4585 (and from 1168:4732 via 1168:4749), never from 912:4520 in the shipping flow. The code's Back is setStep('review') (PublishWizard.tsx:262), i.e. the checklist step drawn as 833:4518, and PublishWizard.tsx:10-16 states the wizard is TWO steps because Options has no backend.
fix: Repoint 914:4545 -> 833:4518 'Publish · pre-checks'. Leave 912:4520 out of the shipping chain until publishInputSchema carries its three controls.

finding: The checklist's primary button is labelled for a step that does not ship, and its own wiring already disagrees with its label.
evidence: Leaf 833:4586 reads "Continue to Options →" but the reaction on its parent frame 833:4585 goes to 914:4507 'Publish · Confirm', skipping 912:4520 entirely. The code's label is 'Continue to Confirm →' (PublishWizard.tsx:229) and the step tuple is ['review','confirm'] (PublishWizard.tsx:130). Note 912:4520's own primary is already labelled 'Continue to Confirm →', so this board is the only one of the three carrying the wrong word.
fix: Change the 833:4586 label to 'Continue to Confirm →'. The wiring is already correct and needs no change.

finding: The wizard is drawn as a three-step stepper on all three modal boards while it ships as two steps, and none of the step pills is clickable.
evidence: Leaf inventories: 833:4522/833:4524/833:4526, 914:4511/914:4513/914:4515 and 893:4522/893:4524/893:4526 all read '1. Review' / '2. Options' / '3. Confirm' with rx=0 on every one. PublishWizard.tsx:130 maps (['review','confirm'] as const) so only two pills render, numbered 1 and 2 (PublishWizard.tsx:139).
fix: Drop the '2. Options' pill from 833:4518, 914:4507 and 893:4518 and renumber Confirm to 2, matching PublishWizard.tsx:130. Restore the third pill when the Options step gains a backend. Whether the pills should be clickable is a separate call — the code renders them as plain <span>, so leaving them inert is consistent.

finding: Every choice control in the export modal is dead, and Cancel and Export as HTML resolve to the same destination — so the design never shows what exporting produces.
evidence: Leaf inventory of 1172:4825: format chips 1174:4807 "HTML", 1174:4810 "ZIP", 1174:4813 "React" and tabs 1174:4826 "Preview", 1174:4828 "Code", 1174:4830 "Options" all rx=0. The only reactions are the frame-level 1172:4825 -> 1171:4767 'Pages · command-palette (⌘K)', 1172:4834 'btn/Cancel' -> 642:3401 'Site menu (⋯)' and 1172:4836 'btn/Export as HTML' -> 642:3401 'Site menu (⋯)' — confirm and cancel land in the same place. (1174:4816 'Vue' and 1174:4821 'Next.js' are labelled 'Soon' and are correctly inert.)
fix: Wire the three live format chips and the three tabs to their own variant boards, and give 'Export as HTML' a distinct destination — an export-in-progress or export-complete state — so it stops being indistinguishable from Cancel.

finding: No board draws a way to cancel a running publish, although cancellation is built end to end and the job can sit in a cancellable state for the whole run.
evidence: Board 784:4250 draws only a progress bar, a meta line and a disabled 'Publishing…' footer button; its leaf set carries no cancel affordance. Editor side: usePublishJob.ts:97 declares cancel in the interface, usePublishJob.ts:228-237 implements it, usePublishJob.ts:333 returns it, PublishService.ts:124-126 calls sites.cancelPublish. Server side the procedure exists (sites.ts:402-426) and accepts QUEUED and BUILDING (publish.service.ts:414). Grep for callers of .cancel() across packages/editor/src finds only tests (usePublishJob.test.ts:390,405,421) — nothing in the UI invokes it, which is exactly what a missing board predicts.
fix: Add a 'Cancel publish' control to 784:4250 and wire it to the cancelled state board (W-D-19). Note the ADMIN restriction in W-D-23 — an EDITOR who may publish may not cancel, so the control needs a refused variant too.

finding: The board's step line can never render: the panel looks for a step status string the worker does not write, so the designed 'Building · step 2 of 4' always degrades to a bare percentage.
evidence: The worker marks the current step status:'active' — buildSteps at workers/publish/[jobId]/route.ts:47 returns { name, status: failed ? 'failed' : 'active' }. The panel looks for 'running': PublishTab.tsx:239 does steps.findIndex((s) => s.status === 'running'), so runningStep is always null and PublishTab.tsx:515-519 falls through (the percentage at :518) to `${publishJob.progress}%`. The same mismatch hits the build log: STEP_WORD (PublishTab.tsx:850-855) maps pending/running/done/failed and has no entry for the worker's actual 'active' or 'skipped' (route.ts:34-37, 43-51), so those render as raw strings.
fix: This is a code fix, not a board fix — the board is right and the panel cannot honour it. Align on one vocabulary: either have the panel match 'active', or have buildSteps write 'running'. Extend STEP_WORD to cover 'skipped' at the same time, since two of the five steps are always skipped.

finding: A legal disclosure renders under the CTA in every state of the shipping panel and is drawn on none of the six panel boards.
evidence: PublishTab.tsx:752-766 renders, outside every conditional branch (sentence at :756): 'By publishing, your site is deployed to your connected Vercel account.' plus underlined 'Privacy policy' and 'Terms of service' links to ${DASHBOARD_URL}/privacy and /terms. The leaf inventory of 641:2652 ends at the footer button I641:2707;9:7 "Publish to production" with no such text, and the screenshots of 778:4238, 781:4489, 784:4250, 784:4326, 784:4403 and 784:4480 show empty space there.
fix: Add the disclosure line to the panel footer on all six boards, below the CTA, as two-line 12px muted text with the two links underlined (the code underlines them deliberately — PublishTab.tsx:750-754 cites WCAG 1.4.1 and a measured 1.27:1 contrast against the surrounding text).

finding: The panel's LAST DEPLOY section is missing its destructive control: the shipping panel puts 'Unpublish site…' directly under the live version row, and the board draws only the row.
evidence: PublishTab.tsx:615-624 (setConfirmUnpublish(true) at :619, label at :623) renders a Button labelled 'Unpublish site…' (or 'Unpublishing…') in --bk-error, gated on snapshot.lastDeploy.isLive && siteId, immediately after the version row. The leaf inventory of 641:2652 shows the section as 641:2702 "v14 · live" and 641:2704 "2 Jul, 14:22" and then goes straight to the spacer 641:2705 and the footer button — no unpublish control at any node.
fix: Draw 'Unpublish site…' under the v14 · live row on 641:2652 in the error tone, and wire it to the confirm dialog from W-D-05. Draw it only in the live variant, matching the isLive gate.

finding: The checklist's Fix links promise navigation to three specific Settings sub-panes that the editor cannot address — every one of them actually lands on the Settings tab root.
evidence: Board wiring sends 833:4542 -> 638:3070 'S7 · Settings · SEO', 833:4554 -> 639:3092 'S7 · Settings · Domains' and 892:4524 -> 638:2378 'S7 · Settings · General'. The code can only switch tabs: FIX_TARGETS maps all three labels to { tab: 'settings' } (PublishTab.tsx:76-82) and the handler emits composer.emit('ui:switch-tab', { tab: target.tab }) (PublishTab.tsx:797-802, emit at :801). PublishTab.tsx:72-74 states it outright: 'ui:switch-tab takes a tab id only (StudioPanels), so SEO / Domain / Favicon all land on Settings rather than their exact pane.'
fix: Either treat the board as the target state and file the deep-link as engineering work, or repoint all three edges at the Settings root board so the prototype stops promising precision the product does not have. Founder call — the board is arguably correct here and the code is behind it.

finding: A publish can end cancelled and no board draws that outcome, so a terminal state of the money path is invisible in the design.
evidence: PublishUiState includes 'cancelled' (usePublishJob.ts:28-33) and is mapped from the job status at usePublishJob.ts:299-310. Server side publish.service.ts:417-428 writes status CANCELLED and flips the site to DRAFT. The section's 14 boards cover loading, load-error, publishing, live, failed and not-connected — the six hotspot chips on 641:2652 (787:4367 through 787:4387) enumerate exactly those six and no cancelled state.
fix: Duplicate 784:4403 and re-word it for cancellation — headline 'Publish cancelled.', the same 'Nothing was deployed.' reassurance, and a single 'Publish to production' footer CTA. Add a seventh hotspot/state chip on 641:2652 pointing to it, and make it the destination of the cancel control in W-D-14.

screen: Publish · pre-checks · blocked on Pages ready (missing)
finding: Only one of the two blocking checks has a blocked board — a site with no live pages is refused just as hard as one with no Vercel connection, and that state is undrawn.
evidence: runPrePublishChecks returns exactly six checks and only two can be a hard fail: 'Vercel connected' (publish.service.ts:59-65) and 'Pages ready' (publish.service.ts:70, detail 'No pages found. Add at least one page before publishing.'), with ready = !checks.some(status === 'fail') (publish.service.ts:108-109). Board 893:4518 draws only the Vercel failure; on it 893:4538/893:4539 draw 'Pages ready' as a green ✓, as does 833:4533/833:4546 on the passing board. No board draws Pages ready failing.
fix: Duplicate 893:4518, flip the Pages ready row to the ✕ disc with detail 'No pages found. Add at least one page before publishing.', put the Vercel row back to ✓, and swap the footer CTA for the checklist's normal 'Fix ›' route to 140:2 'Pages · tree' rather than Connect Vercel. Band copy follows PublishWizard.tsx:210 — '⚠ 1 blocking — Pages ready. Fix to publish.'

finding: The build log that 'View log' opens has no board, so the one surface that tells a user which build step failed and which never ran is undesigned.
evidence: PublishTab.tsx:371-405 renders a <ul aria-label='Build log'> of the job's steps, each with a status glyph (✕ / ✓ / ·) and a word from STEP_WORD (PublishTab.tsx:846-851, where 'pending' reads 'not run'). The data is real: the worker writes five named steps — 'Generating pages', 'Optimizing images', 'Deploying to CDN', 'Verifying SSL', 'Performance check' (workers/publish/[jobId]/route.ts:22-28) — and PublishService.ts:40-49 documents carrying them through specifically for this board's link.
fix: Duplicate 784:4403 with the log open: five rows under the 'Try again · Hide log' line, glyph plus step name plus status word. Draw at least one 'skipped' row — indices 1 and 4 are never run (route.ts:34-37) — so the design covers the status the code currently has no word for (see W-D-15).

finding: There is no board for a user who is not allowed to publish — the role refusal is a distinct server state from the two the design does cover, and it is drawn nowhere.
evidence: sites.publish requires site-role EDITOR (sites.ts:324, checkSiteRole(..., 'EDITOR')); a VIEWER (rank 0 in permission.service.ts:4-11) is refused with FORBIDDEN 'Insufficient permissions' (permission.service.ts:126-127). This is neither of the drawn blocks: 784:4480 is 'publishing not wired at all' (noPublishPath = !canPublish, PublishTab.tsx:324 with canPublish at :160, and the comment at PublishTab.tsx:311-323) and 893:4518 is the Vercel check failing. A site-scoped member outside their grant gets a third string, 'You don't have access to this site.' (permission.service.ts:57).
fix: Duplicate 784:4480 — it is already the shape for 'this panel has no publish path', a sentence plus a single CTA — and re-word: headline naming the restriction, and either no footer CTA or one that routes to whoever can publish. Add a hotspot/state chip on 641:2652 alongside the existing six.

finding: A designer who is allowed to publish is not allowed to undo it — publish is EDITOR but cancel, unpublish and rollback are all ADMIN — and the design draws one panel for both, so the take-down control will 403 for the very role the product tells to publish.
evidence: sites.publish -> EDITOR (sites.ts:324, with the comment at sites.ts:316-322: 'a DESIGNER (EDITOR site-role) may publish… the design draws Publish as Allowed for a designer'). sites.cancelPublish -> ADMIN (sites.ts:411), sites.unpublish -> ADMIN (sites.ts:432), sites.rollback -> ADMIN (sites.ts:485). The editor applies no role gate to the control it renders: PublishTab.tsx:615-624 shows 'Unpublish site…' whenever snapshot.lastDeploy.isLive && siteId, with no role check anywhere in the file.
fix: Draw the EDITOR variant of 641:2652 without the unpublish control, and a refusal state for the ADMIN-only actions ('Only an admin can take this site offline'). This also decides the code fix — the control should be role-gated rather than shown and refused.

finding: The open-errors safety gate sits on the topbar publish path only; the panel-and-wizard path the section is built around never raises it, so publishing from the Publish panel ships known errors with no warning.
evidence: The gate is real and topbar-only: StudioHeader.tsx:662-672, handleCtaClick — if (errorCount > 0) { setPubConfirm(true); return; } — rendering the modal at StudioHeader.tsx:853-860 with the board's own copy. Neither PublishTab.tsx nor PublishWizard.tsx references issues or errorCount anywhere; the wizard's only gate is checks.ready (PublishWizard.tsx:126, 228). The Figma graph agrees: 1168:4732 in=1, and that inbound is 52:2 'S1 · Editor — ASSEMBLED' via the reviewer chip 1168:4753, not the publish flow. Its own outbound 1168:4749 'btn/Publish anyway' -> 914:4507 places it before Confirm, where nothing sends the user to it.
fix: Wire 833:4518 -> 1168:4732 as the has-open-errors branch (a hotspot/alt, the way 893:6935 branches to the blocked checklist), so the drawn flow shows the gate on both doors. Then decide whether the panel path should raise it in code too — today the two doors to publish do not enforce the same gate.

finding: The ENVIRONMENT rows carry a chevron on all three panel boards but no reaction, and on the panel the frame-level edge sends the click to the pre-checks modal instead of the site.
evidence: Leaf inventories: 641:2670 "bellacucina.com" + 641:2671 "›" rx=0 and 641:2675 + 641:2676 rx=0 on 641:2652; 784:4395/784:4396 and 784:4400/784:4401 rx=0 on 784:4326; 784:4472/784:4473 and 784:4477/784:4478 rx=0 on 784:4403. 641:2652 carries a frame-level ON_CLICK -> 833:4518, so a click on the domain opens the checklist. In code the Production row is a real external link and the Preview row is not: EnvRow renders <a href> only when href is passed (PublishTab.tsx:91-113, link branch :97-107), and it is passed publishedUrl for Production (PublishTab.tsx:535-539, href at :538) and nothing for Preview (PublishTab.tsx:541).
fix: Give the Production row its own edge to the same external-site terminal used in W-D-03, and drop the chevron from the Preview row on all three boards — the code has no link behind it, so the chevron is promising navigation that does not exist.

finding: Both publish-anyway decision modals are drawn with two forward actions and no way out — no Cancel, no close affordance — so the drawn flow forces a choice between shipping unapproved work and leaving the publish.
evidence: Leaf inventory and reactions for 1168:4713 show only 1168:4728 'btn/Request fresh review' -> 128:2 and 1168:4730 'btn/Publish anyway' -> 784:4250; for 1168:4732 only 1168:4747 'btn/Fix issues first' -> 164:2 and 1168:4749 'btn/Publish anyway' -> 914:4507. Neither board draws a Cancel or an ✕. Both are dismissible in code: the issues modal is a ModalRoot with onOpenChange closing it (StudioHeader.tsx:854) and its safe action takes autoFocus (StudioHeader.tsx:917).
fix: Add the escape affordance to both boards — an ✕ or a Cancel that returns to 641:2652 — matching the ModalRoot dismissal the code already provides. Neither board is labelled TERMINAL by design.
